summary: @onereach/si-checkbox preinstall fetches Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue checkbox UI component but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball with rotating string arrays and `_0x`-style hex identifiers that render it non-human-readable. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator-style identifier scrambling and per-call string-lookup objects to hide the URL parts, command flags, and platform strings used to fetch and launch the runtime. The Bun runtime is used solely to execute the bundled opaque payload; nothing about a checkbox UI component requires an alternate JavaScript runtime. On every `npm install`, an arbitrary attacker-controlled script runs on the installer's machine under a runtime that Node-based tooling cannot inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
